intent: Give every later change set a typed, linted, testable place to land.
change: pnpm workspace with ARCHITECTURE section-11 package stubs, strict tsconfig, eslint, Vitest config, and a pnpm check script (lint + typecheck + unit + integration + build).
done_when: Fresh clone plus documented install runs pnpm check green locally with one sample unit test per package stub.

proofs.claim: The one-command quality gate runs eslint, tsc over the build and test configs, both vitest projects under the coverage thresholds, and the workspace build, and exits zero.
Every ARCHITECTURE section 11 package resolves through its workspace entry point and is exercised by its own unit test.

intent: One command brings up local Postgres; integration tests own their database.
change: docker-compose with Postgres for local dev plus a Testcontainers harness and shared Drizzle client wiring for integration tests.
done_when: An integration test boots Testcontainers Postgres, connects through the shared client, and pnpm check includes it.

intent: Pin the section-5 data model once so later sprints never rework the substrate.
change: Drizzle schema for all section-5 tables (users, site_connections, watches, observations, tasks, task_events, calendar_items, messages) and the generated migration set.
done_when: Migrations apply to a fresh Testcontainers Postgres, re-apply as a no-op, and the exported Drizzle types compile in dependent stubs.

intent: Durable scheduled and queued work on plain Postgres for every engine that follows.
change: Typed pg-boss wrapper: named handler registration, enqueue, cron schedules, retry defaults, observable failed state, worker entry point.
done_when: Integration tests prove cron fires, a queued job round-trips, a failing handler retries then fails observably, and a job enqueued before a worker restart executes after it.

intent: A Fastify server later surfaces plug routes into, with typed config and errors.
change: Fastify app factory, env-driven typed config loading, health route, JSON-schema validation setup, and a machine-readable 4xx error envelope.
done_when: App boots in test, /health returns 200, malformed JSON body returns the typed 400 envelope.

intent: Engine-free CRUD so chat and dashboard build in parallel with the watch engine.
change: Watches create/list/pause, calendar-items create/list, tasks read - thin Drizzle-backed Fastify routes with JSON-schema validation, no engine behavior.
done_when: Integration tests cover accepted and refused cases per route family against Testcontainers, refused requests persisting nothing.

intent: Nothing merges red; the quality bar is enforced, not aspirational.
change: GitHub Actions push workflow running pnpm check with coverage gates (100 percent on core, 90 percent overall), plus PR template with manual-checklist stub.
done_when: Workflow is green on the sprint PR and a unit test of the coverage config proves the gate fails on a synthetic uncovered branch.

intent: A stranger can go from clone to green without tribal knowledge.
change: Documented .env.example, root README dev setup (install, compose up, migrate, pnpm check), and scripts referenced by the docs actually existing.
done_when: The integration boot path uses only documented steps and pnpm check passes following the README verbatim on a clean checkout.
